# Thrive Hyperbaric

> Hard-shell hyperbaric chambers, specified, installed and supported worldwide by Thrive - run from a working hyperbaric clinic in Bath. Thrive is the official HPO.TECH worldwide specialist.

## Chambers

- [Models](https://www.thrivehyperbaric.com/models): Hard-shell hyperbaric chambers, from single-seat home models to multi-person clinical chambers.
- [Home use](https://www.thrivehyperbaric.com/home-use): The same certified hard-shell hyperbaric chambers we run in our clinic every day, used by Bryan Johnson and available in your home.
- [Elite sport](https://www.thrivehyperbaric.com/sport): Hard-shell hyperbaric chambers built for elite sport - the chambers used across the NFL, NHL and elite football, at the dose the research uses.
- [Commercial](https://www.thrivehyperbaric.com/commercial): Hard-shell hyperbaric chambers for wellness facilities, gyms and clinics.

## Buying and specifying

- [Buying guide](https://www.thrivehyperbaric.com/buying-guide): What to look for in a hyperbaric chamber, what each category costs, and why oxygen delivery decides whether it reaches the research dose.
- [FAQ](https://www.thrivehyperbaric.com/faq): Who you buy from, hard vs soft-shell, safety, cost, delivery, and approvals in the UK, US and beyond.
- [For architects and designers](https://www.thrivehyperbaric.com/specifiers): Dimensions, services, access and programme for specifying a hyperbaric chamber into a scheme.
- [Certifications](https://www.thrivehyperbaric.com/certifications): CE, ISO 13485, PED, ASME PVHO, NFPA and independent inspection.
